description:
Extra Colony Items

Add some colony items to Starsector.

Source code

|

Changelog and older versions

Required mods:

MagicLib

|

LazyLib

Adding to an ongoing game:

Yes, it's safe

Removing from an ongoing game:

Destroy the items from the save first

What is this?

Just a mod that add colony items.

A total of 6 new colony items.6 new bounties to get them.4 bounties will be unlocked once the player reach level 8.1 bounty will be unlocked once the player reach level 15, then 1 more will be unlocked once this bounty is successfully completed.

Some previews

Items preview

REDACTED[close][close]

FAQ

FAQ

Loot pool dilution?

No, I didn't put them in normal loot table, you should only get the items from the bounties or if another mod spawn them.

Balance?

4 items were balanced around vanilla (at least that's the intention), so please report if you feel they are overtuned. The other 2 not so much, but I can tweak them if they feel too op (like the multiplier being too high).

AI?

Not used or involved at all in making this mod, unless you count some auto-complete thing. It's all human code slop and human scuffed image editing.[close]Changelog

1.0.3: Initial forum release.

[close]

Please send any feedback or bug reports here, I would really appreciate that.

aiDescription: Introduces six new colony items that can be obtained through specific bounties. Four of these bounties unlock at player level 8, while one unlocks at level 15, with a final bounty becoming available after completing the level 15 one. The items are not added to the standard loot tables, ensuring they are primarily acquired through these new objectives.
